title: Inference Auctions
abstract: arXiv:2609.40070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When inference demand exceeds available compute capacity, model providers must decide which requests should be served first. Users have different tolerances for delay from an LLM API, but current priority pricing schemes compress these differences into coarse fixed-price service tiers. We design an inference auction that allows users to bid for faster service. Our auction allocates priority in an economically efficient way without sacrificing latency, and we develop fast algorithms for implementing prices that incentivize truthful bidding. We also design an autobidding agent for our inference auction, where users specify an inference budget and the autobidder dynamically adjusts its bids over time to maximize user utility subject to the budget constraint. translated_abstract: 当推理需求超过可用的计算容量时，模型提供商必须决定优先服务哪些请求。用户对LLM API的延迟容忍度各不相同，但目前的优先级定价方案将这些差异压缩为粗糙的固定价格服务层级。我们设计了一种推理拍卖机制，允许用户通过竞价获得更快的服务。我们的拍卖以一种经济高效的方式分配优先级，且不牺牲延迟，并开发了快速算法来实现激励用户真实出价的价格机制。我们还为该推理拍卖设计了一个自动出价代理，用户只需指定推理预算，自动出价代理便会在预算约束下随时间动态调整出价，以最大化用户效用。实验验证了该拍卖机制的实用性：它在提升系统福利的同时，保持了SGLang（一种最先进的推理引擎）在缓存利用率和延迟方面的优势。
tldr: 提出了一种让用户通过竞价换取更快LLM推理服务的拍卖机制，以经济高效的方式分配推理优先级并通过价格激励真实出价，配合自动出价代理在预算约束下最大化用户效用，实验证明其在提升系统福利的同时保持了SGLang的缓存利用率和延迟优势。
en_tdlr: Proposes an inference auction that allows users to bid for faster LLM service, allocating priority efficiently with prices that incentivize truthful bidding and an autobidding agent that maximizes utility under budget constraints, which increases system welfare while preserving SGLang's cache utilization and latency advantages.
